90-dev-reset-db:
91-	@echo "Stopping all containers and removing volumes (this destroys all local DB data)..."
92-	docker compose down --volumes
93-	@echo "Starting postgres first to ensure roles are provisioned..."
94-	docker compose up -d postgres
95-	@echo "Waiting for postgres to be ready..."
96-	@until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres -q; do sleep 1; done
97-	@echo "Starting all services (the server will run migrations on startup)..."
98-	docker compose up -d
